```{r libraries, message=FALSE}
library(CellWalkR)
library(ArchR)
library(Seurat) # For scRNA-seq data handling and mock spatial data
library(Matrix)
library(ggplot2)
library(data.table)
library(GenomicRanges) # For ATAC-seq peak handling
library(FNN) # For KNN search in spatial data
set.seed(123) # For reproducibility
```

```{r data import and processing}
# Set ArchR threads
addArchRThreads(threads = 1) 

# Download tutorial data. 
inputFiles <- getTutorialData("Hematopoiesis") 

# Add genome annotation
addArchRGenome("hg19")

# Create Arrow Files
ArrowFiles <- createArrowFiles(
  inputFiles = inputFiles,
  sampleNames = names(inputFiles),
  filterTSS = 4,
  filterFrags = 1000, 
  addTileMat = TRUE,
  addGeneScoreMat = TRUE
)

# Infer Doublets
doubScores <- addDoubletScores(
  input = ArrowFiles,
  k = 10,
  knnMethod = "UMAP",
  LSIMethod = 1
)

# Create ArchRProject
proj <- ArchRProject(
  ArrowFiles = ArrowFiles, 
  outputDirectory = "HemeTutorial",
  copyArrows = TRUE 
)

# Filter Doublets
proj <- filterDoublets(ArchRProj = proj)

# Dimensionality Reduction and Clustering
proj <- addIterativeLSI(ArchRProj = proj, useMatrix = "TileMatrix", name = "IterativeLSI")
proj <- addClusters(input = proj, reducedDims = "IterativeLSI")

# --- Now, how CellWalker2 uses this ArchRProject ---
```

```{r using ArchR in CellWalker}
# 1. Compute cell-to-cell similarity from ArchRProject
#    This will create a cell-by-cell similarity matrix using the 'TileMatrix'
atac_cell_graph_archr <- computeCellSim(proj, method = "sparseJaccard")
message("Dimensions of ATAC cell graph from ArchRProject: ", paste(dim(atac_cell_graph_archr), collapse = "x"))

# 2. Map peaks to genes (requires marker genes and genomic regions)
#    For demonstration, let's load sample marker genes and genomic regions
data("SampleCellWalkRData") 
labelGenes_atac <- SampleCellWalkRData$labelGenes
regions_atac <- getRegions(genome = "hg38") 

atac_gene_peak_map <- mapArchRToGenes(labelGenes_atac, proj, whichMat = "TileMatrix", regions = regions_atac)
message("Structure of ATAC gene-peak map (first label):")
str(atac_gene_peak_map[[1]])

# 3. Compute cell-to-label edges
atac_label_edges <- computeLabelEdges(labelGenes_atac, proj, atac_gene_peak_map, method = "None", whichMat = "TileMatrix")
message("Dimensions of ATAC label edges: ", paste(dim(atac_label_edges), collapse = "x"))
```

```{r mock spatial data generation}
  rpois(num_cells * num_genes, lambda = 1),

  sparse = TRUE

# Generate random spatial coordinates

  x = runif(num_cells, 0, 100),
  y = runif(num_cells, 0, 100)
)
rownames(spatial_coords) <- colnames(mock_rna_counts)

# Create a Seurat object (can be used to represent spatial data, e.g., 10x Visium)

# Extract spatial coordinates for use in graph creation
spatial_coords_matrix <- as.matrix(mock_seurat_obj@meta.data[, c("spatial_x", "spatial_y")])
```

```{r helper function}
#' Create Spatial KNN Graph
#'
#' \code{createSpatialKNNGraph()} computes a cell-to-cell similarity matrix based on spatial proximity
#' using a K-nearest neighbors approach.
#'
#' @param spatialCoords matrix or data.frame with columns for spatial x and y coordinates,
#'                      rownames should be cell barcodes.
#' @param k_neighbors integer, the number of nearest neighbors to consider for each cell.
#' @return a sparseMatrix of cell-to-cell similarity, with values normalized between 0 and 1.
#' @export
createSpatialKNNGraph <- function(spatialCoords, k_neighbors = 10) {
  if (!requireNamespace("FNN", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Package 'FNN' is required for spatial KNN graph. Please install it with install.packages('FNN')")
  }
  if (missing(spatialCoords) || !(is.matrix(spatialCoords) || is.data.frame(spatialCoords))) {
    stop("Must provide 'spatialCoords' as a matrix or data.frame with cell barcodes as rownames.")
  }
  if (ncol(spatialCoords) < 2) {
    stop("'spatialCoords' must have at least two columns (e.g., x and y coordinates).")
  }
  if (is.null(rownames(spatialCoords))) {
    stop("'spatialCoords' must have rownames (cell barcodes).")
  }
  if (k_neighbors >= nrow(spatialCoords)) {
    warning("'k_neighbors' is greater than or equal to the number of cells. Setting k_neighbors to num_cells - 1.")
    k_neighbors <- nrow(spatialCoords) - 1
  }
  if (k_neighbors < 1) {
    stop("'k_neighbors' must be at least 1.")
  }

  message("Computing spatial distances and KNN graph...")
  
  # Compute k-nearest neighbors
  # FNN::get.knn finds k-nearest neighbors and their distances
  knn_result <- FNN::get.knn(spatialCoords, k = k_neighbors)
  
  # Create adjacency list for KNN graph
  # Each cell 'i' is connected to its 'k_neighbors' neighbors 'j'
  adj_list_i <- rep(1:nrow(spatialCoords), each = k_neighbors)
  adj_list_j <- as.vector(knn_result$index)
  
  # Distances to neighbors
  distances <- as.vector(knn_result$distance)
  
  # Normalize distances to create similarity scores (0 to 1, where 1 is most similar/closest)
  # A common approach for similarity: 1 - (distance / max_distance_in_set)
  # We find the max distance *among the k-nearest neighbors* to normalize for meaningful local similarities.
  max_dist_in_knn <- max(distances)
  if (max_dist_in_knn == 0) { 
    # Handle case where all distances are 0 (e.g., all spatial points are identical, or k=1 with duplicates)
    similarity <- rep(1, length(distances)) 
  } else {
    similarity <- 1 - (distances / max_dist_in_knn)
  }
  
  # Build a sparse adjacency matrix
  # Ensure indices are valid (should be by FNN, but good practice)
  valid_indices <- adj_list_j <= nrow(spatialCoords) & adj_list_j >= 1
  adj_list_i <- adj_list_i[valid_indices]
  adj_list_j <- adj_list_j[valid_indices]
  similarity <- similarity[valid_indices]

  spatial_graph <- Matrix::sparseMatrix(
    i = adj_list_i,
    j = adj_list_j,
    x = similarity,
    dims = c(nrow(spatialCoords), nrow(spatialCoords)),
    dimnames = list(rownames(spatialCoords), rownames(spatialCoords))
  )
  
  # Make the graph symmetric (undirected) by taking the maximum of A and A_transpose.
  # If cell A is a neighbor of B, then B should be a neighbor of A for consistent influence.
  spatial_graph <- pmax(spatial_graph, t(spatial_graph))
  
  # Set diagonal to 1 (self-similarity, a cell is maximally similar to itself)
  diag(spatial_graph) <- 1

  message("Spatial KNN graph created.")
  return(spatial_graph)
}

#' Combine Multiple Cell-to-Cell Graphs
#'
#' \code{combineMultiModalCellGraphs()} takes a list of cell-to-cell similarity matrices
#' and combines them into a single matrix using a weighted sum. This allows integrating
#' similarity information from different modalities (e.g., RNA, ATAC, Spatial).
#'
#' @param listOfCellGraphs list of sparseMatrix or matrix objects, each representing
#'                         cell-to-cell similarity. Rownames and colnames must be consistent
#'                         across all matrices and represent cell barcodes.
#' @param weights numeric vector of weights, corresponding to the order of matrices
#'                in `listOfCellGraphs`. Weights will be normalized to sum to 1.
#' @return a sparseMatrix representing the combined cell-to-cell similarity graph.
#' @export
combineMultiModalCellGraphs <- function(listOfCellGraphs, weights) {
  if (missing(listOfCellGraphs) || !is.list(listOfCellGraphs) || length(listOfCellGraphs) == 0) {
    stop("Must provide 'listOfCellGraphs' as a non-empty list of matrices.")
  }
  if (missing(weights) || !is.numeric(weights) || length(weights) != length(listOfCellGraphs)) {
    stop("Must provide 'weights' as a numeric vector of the same length as 'listOfCellGraphs'.")
  }
  if (sum(weights) != 1) {
    message("Weights do not sum to 1. Normalizing weights to sum to 1.")
    weights <- weights / sum(weights)
  }

  # Validate matrix dimensions and names for consistency
  first_graph <- listOfCellGraphs[[1]]
  num_cells <- nrow(first_graph)
  cell_names <- rownames(first_graph)

  if (is.null(cell_names)) {
    stop("All matrices in 'listOfCellGraphs' must have rownames (cell barcodes).")
  }

  for (i in 2:length(listOfCellGraphs)) {
    current_graph <- listOfCellGraphs[[i]]
    if (!all.equal(dim(current_graph), c(num_cells, num_cells))) {
      stop(paste0("Graph ", i, " has inconsistent dimensions. All graphs must be ", num_cells, "x", num_cells, "."))
    }
    # Check if cell names are exactly the same and in the same order
    if (!identical(rownames(current_graph), cell_names) || !identical(colnames(current_graph), cell_names)) {
      stop(paste0("Graph ", i, " has inconsistent cell names or order. All graphs must have the same rownames/colnames in the same order. Please reorder matrices if necessary."))
    }
  }

  message("Combining cell graphs using weighted sum...")
  # Initialize combined graph with appropriate dimensions and sparsity
  combined_graph <- Matrix::Matrix(0, nrow = num_cells, ncol = num_cells, sparse = TRUE, dimnames = list(cell_names, cell_names))

  # Perform weighted sum
  for (i in 1:length(listOfCellGraphs)) {
    combined_graph <- combined_graph + (listOfCellGraphs[[i]] * weights[i])
  }
  
  message("Multi-modal cell graph created.")
  return(combined_graph)
}
```

```{r spatial cell graph}
spatial_knn_graph <- createSpatialKNNGraph(spatial_coords_matrix, k_neighbors = 15)
message("Dimensions of Spatial KNN graph: ", paste(dim(spatial_knn_graph), collapse = "x"))


# Combine RNA, ATAC and spatial graphs

# Ensure all graphs have consistent cell order and names for combination
# We'll use the cell order from the ArchR project (atac_cell_graph_archr) as the reference.
reference_cells <- rownames(atac_cell_graph_archr)

# Reorder/subset RNA graph
rna_cell_graph_ordered <- rna_cell_graph[reference_cells, reference_cells]

# Reorder/subset Spatial graph
spatial_knn_graph_ordered <- spatial_knn_graph[reference_cells, reference_cells]

# ATAC graph is already in the correct order (from ArchR)
atac_cell_graph_archr_ordered <- atac_cell_graph_archr[reference_cells, reference_cells]


message("Number of common cells for combination: ", length(reference_cells))

# Create a list of graphs to combine (order matters for weights)
list_of_graphs_to_combine <- list(
  rna_cell_graph_ordered, 
  spatial_knn_graph_ordered,
  atac_cell_graph_archr_ordered
)

# Define weights for each modality (e.g., 0.4 for RNA, 0.3 for Spatial, 0.3 for ATAC)
# These weights will be normalized to sum to 1 by the function.
modal_weights <- c(0.4, 0.3, 0.3) 

combined_cell_graph <- combineMultiModalCellGraphs(list_of_graphs_to_combine, modal_weights)
message("Dimensions of Combined Multi-Modal Cell Graph: ", paste(dim(combined_cell_graph), collapse = "x"))

# Verify properties (e.g., symmetry, diagonal)

# all(diag(combined_cell_graph) == 1)
```

```{r running CellWalker2 with combined graph}
# For simplicity, let's assume we have some arbitrary cell types in our mock data
mock_seurat_obj$mock_cell_type <- sample(paste0("Type_", 1:5), size = ncol(mock_seurat_obj), replace = TRUE)
# Ensure cell names are consistent before adding to Seurat obj if it was subsetted earlier
mock_seurat_obj <- mock_seurat_obj[, reference_cells] 
Idents(mock_seurat_obj) <- "mock_cell_type"

# Find mock markers from the processed RNA data
mock_markers <- FindAllMarkers(mock_seurat_obj, only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25)
mock_markers <- data.frame(gene = mock_markers$gene, cluster = mock_markers$cluster, avg_log2FC = mock_markers$avg_log2FC)

# Create mock label edges using the normalized RNA expression data
# Ensure the expression matrix has the same cell order as the combined graph
rna_expr_norm_ordered <- rna_processed_output$expr_norm[, reference_cells]
mock_label_edges <- computeTypeEdges(rna_expr_norm_ordered, mock_markers)

# The mock_label_edges should now have rows corresponding to `reference_cells`.
# The combined_cell_graph also has these cells.
message("Dimensions of mock label edges: ", paste(dim(mock_label_edges), collapse = "x"))


# running walkCells from CellWalker to test compatibility

label_edges_list_final <- list(mock_label_edges)
# Example label edge weight. In a real scenario, this would be tuned using tuneEdgeWeights.
label_edge_weights_final <- c(1000) 

message("Running walkCells with the combined multi-modal graph...")
cell_walk_results_spatial <- walkCells(
  cellEdges = combined_cell_graph,
  labelEdgesList = label_edges_list_final,
  labelEdgeWeights = label_edge_weights_final,
  sampleDepth = min(2000, nrow(combined_cell_graph)) # Adjust sample depth for tuning/speed if needed
)

message("CellWalker results obtained with spatial integration:")
print(head(cell_walk_results_spatial$cellLabels))
```

```{r data import tests}
# 1) prepare ATAC counts (sparse dgCMatrix)
counts_atac <- as(assay(sce, "X"), "dgCMatrix") 

# 2) parse peak names into GRanges (row names look like "chr:start-end")
peaks <- rownames(sce)
# Use Signac helper
gr_peaks <- tryCatch(
  StringToGRanges(peaks),
  error = function(e) {
    # fallback: manual parsing
    parsed <- strcapture("^([^:]+):(\\d+)-(\\d+)$", peaks,
                         proto = data.frame(chr=character(), start=integer(), end=integer()))
    if (nrow(parsed) != length(peaks)) stop("Peak names not in expected chr:start-end format")
    GRanges(seqnames = parsed$chr,
            ranges = IRanges(start = as.integer(parsed$start), end = as.integer(parsed$end)))
  }
)

# 3) create ChromatinAssay (sparse-safe)
chrom_assay <- CreateChromatinAssay(
  counts = counts_atac,
  ranges = gr_peaks,
  sep = c(":", "-"),
  genome = "hg38"
)

# 4) create Seurat object using the chromatin assay and existing colData
meta <- as.data.frame(colData(sce))
seurat_atac <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = chrom_assay, assay = "peaks", meta.data = meta)
DefaultAssay(seurat_atac) <- "peaks"




# 1) bounding-box filter for RNA and ATAC
bbox_filter <- function(seurat_rna, seurat_atac,
                        x_min = 5000, x_max = 11000, y_min_atac = 4000) {
  seurat_rna@meta.data <- seurat_rna@meta.data %>%
    filter(!is.na(x_centroid) & !is.na(y_centroid) &
           x_centroid >= x_min & x_centroid <= x_max)
  seurat_atac@meta.data <- seurat_atac@meta.data %>%
    filter(!is.na(xcor) & !is.na(ycor) & ycor >= y_min_atac)
  invisible(list(rna = seurat_rna, atac = seurat_atac))
}

# 2) proximity filter: remove isolated points with fewer than min_neighbors within radius (euclidean)
proximity_filter <- function(meta, xcol, ycol, radius = 50, min_neighbors = 1) {
  coords <- as.matrix(meta[, c(xcol, ycol)])
  # compute pairwise squared distances efficiently
  rx <- coords[,1]; ry <- coords[,2]
  # vectorized squared distance: (xi-xj)^2+(yi-yj)^2
  # using crossprod trick is memory-heavy; do blockwise if very large.
  n <- nrow(coords)
  if (n == 0) return(meta[0,,drop=FALSE])
  # Use RANN for speed if available, fallback to simple loop
  if (requireNamespace("RANN", quietly = TRUE)) {
    nn <- RANN::nn2(coords, coords, k = min(100, n))$nn.dists  # distances to neighbors
    # count neighbors within radius (exclude self at distance 0)
    within <- rowSums(nn <= radius) - 1
    keep <- within >= min_neighbors
  } else {
    # small/medium n fallback: compute squared distances in blocks
    keep <- logical(n)
    r2 <- radius * radius
    for (i in seq_len(n)) {
      dx <- rx - rx[i]
      dy <- ry - ry[i]
      d2 <- dx*dx + dy*dy
      # exclude self, count others within radius
      keep[i] <- sum(d2 <= r2) - 1 >= min_neighbors
    }
  }
  meta[keep, , drop = FALSE]
}

# apply bbox
res <- bbox_filter(seurat_rna, seurat_atac, x_min = 4700, x_max = 10100, y_min_atac = 4000)
seurat_rna_f <- res$rna
seurat_atac_f <- res$atac

# apply proximity filter 
seurat_rna_f@meta.data <- proximity_filter(seurat_rna_f@meta.data, "x_centroid", "y_centroid", radius = 50, min_neighbors = 10)
seurat_atac_f@meta.data <- proximity_filter(seurat_atac_f@meta.data, "xcor", "ycor", radius = 50, min_neighbors = 5)
```

```{r plot spatials}
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(dplyr)

# concise, professional spatial plot: RNA (x_centroid,y_centroid) above ATAC (xcor,ycor)
plot_spatial_rna_atac <- function(seurat_rna, seurat_atac,
                                  color_by = NULL,
                                  pt_size = 0.6, pt_alpha = 0.8,
                                  same_limits = FALSE,
                                  rna_title = "RNA (spatial)",
                                  atac_title = "ATAC (spatial)") {
  # extract and rename coords
  df_rna <- seurat_rna@meta.data %>%
    transmute(x = as.numeric(x_centroid), y = as.numeric(y_centroid),
              .col = if (!is.null(color_by)) .data[[color_by]] else NULL)
  df_atac <- seurat_atac@meta.data %>%
    transmute(x = as.numeric(xcor), y = as.numeric(ycor),
              .col = if (!is.null(color_by)) .data[[color_by]] else NULL)
  if (!is.null(color_by)) {
    names(df_rna)[3] <- names(df_atac)[3] <- color_by
  }

  # common limits
  if (same_limits) {
    xlim <- range(c(df_rna$x, df_atac$x), na.rm = TRUE)
    ylim <- range(c(df_rna$y, df_atac$y), na.rm = TRUE)
  } else { xlim <- ylim <- NULL }

  make_plot <- function(df, title) {
    p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = -y)) +
      coord_fixed() + ggtitle(title) + theme_minimal() +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
    if (!is.null(xlim)) p <- p + xlim(xlim) + ylim(ylim)
    if (!is.null(color_by)) {
      if (is.numeric(df[[color_by]])) {
        p <- p + geom_point(aes_string(color = color_by), size = pt_size, alpha = pt_alpha) +
          scale_color_viridis_c()
      } else {
        p <- p + geom_point(aes_string(color = color_by), size = pt_size, alpha = pt_alpha) +
          scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1", na.value = "grey70")
      }
    } else {
      p <- p + geom_point(color = "#2c3e50", size = pt_size, alpha = pt_alpha)
    }
    p + xlab("x") + ylab("y")
  }
  
  make_plot2 <- function(df, title) {
    p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
      coord_fixed() + ggtitle(title) + theme_minimal() +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
    if (!is.null(xlim)) p <- p + xlim(xlim) + ylim(ylim)
    if (!is.null(color_by)) {
      if (is.numeric(df[[color_by]])) {
        p <- p + geom_point(aes_string(color = color_by), size = pt_size, alpha = pt_alpha) +
          scale_color_viridis_c()
      } else {
        p <- p + geom_point(aes_string(color = color_by), size = pt_size, alpha = pt_alpha) +
          scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1", na.value = "grey70")
      }
    } else {
      p <- p + geom_point(color = "#2c3e50", size = pt_size, alpha = pt_alpha)
    }
    p + xlab("x") + ylab("y")
  }

  p_rna <- make_plot(df_rna, rna_title)
  p_atac <- make_plot2(df_atac, atac_title)

  plot_grid(p_rna, p_atac, ncol = 1, align = "v", rel_heights = c(1, 1))
}


p <- plot_spatial_rna_atac(seurat_rna_f, seurat_atac_f, color_by = NULL)
ggsave("/projectnb/paxlab/phitro/figures/spatial_RNA-ATAC_filtered.png", p)
```
